headline: WEST AND RUSSIA AGAIN AT WAR WITH EACH OTHER OPINION BY SCARVID ARTÉ

However, the West also needs questioning due to leading military interventions outside legality such as Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya. Moreover, May seems to forget Western countries have given enough reasons throughout history for why Eurasian giant should distrust them. headline: Con marcha exigen obras al Ejecutivo
